rules.title: Routing Rules
rules.purpose: Declarative request-routing rules per organization. Higher priority wins.
rules.draftBanner: Draft pre-filled from the quality screen: "{{from}}" → "{{to}}". Nothing is saved — review and create it yourself.
rules.fixErrorsFirst: Fix the match expression errors first
rules.builderEmpty: Build the expression with the selector below, or type it directly. See the syntax reference under the form.
rules.builderValid: Expression looks valid: it uses known fields and operators and will be evaluated by the rules engine.
rules.syntaxReference: Syntax reference (as implemented by the rules engine)
rules.syntaxIntro: Fields: org_id, model_requested, session_id, client_ip, user_agent. Operators (spaces required): ==, !=, contains, starts_with, ends_with, in, not_in. Logic: && binds tighter than ||. No parentheses, no wildcards.
rules.syntaxExamples:
model_requested starts_with "gpt-4"
model_requested in gpt-4,gpt-4o && org_id != acme
client_ip == 10.0.0.1 || user_agent contains opencode
rules.syntaxOutcome: Higher priority wins when several rules match; the matched rule’s target model replaces the request’s model. A rule that does not parse never matches — the validator above blocks those before creation.
rules.empty: No routing rules for this organization yet. Use “New rule” to create the first one.
rules.exprUnbalancedQuote: Unbalanced {{quote}} quote — the parser will treat the rest of the expression as one value.
rules.exprNoParentheses: Parentheses are not supported. Use && / || precedence (&& binds tighter than ||).
rules.exprNoWildcard: Wildcard * is not supported. Use starts_with / ends_with instead (e.g. model_requested starts_with "gpt-4").
rules.exprNoOperator: No comparison operator found — this rule would never match. Supported: ==  !=  contains  starts_with  ends_with  in  not_in (spaces required).
rules.exprUnknownField: Unknown field "{{field}}". Supported fields: org_id, model_requested, session_id, client_ip, user_agent.
rules.exprSpacesWarning: Operators need spaces on both sides (a == b, not a==b).
rules.deleteConfirm: Delete this routing rule? This cannot be undone.
rules.previewHint: The draft is evaluated by the server with the same rules engine as the gateway. The organization scope comes from your admin session, not from these inputs.
rules.previewNoMatch: Does not match the sample — the requested model keeps its route
rules.previewInvalid: The server rejected the expression: it does not parse against the rules grammar and would never match
rules.orderHint: Rules are evaluated from the highest priority to the lowest: the first enabled rule whose expression matches routes the request to its target; lower-priority rules are skipped.
rules.orgRequired: Select an organization in the top bar to see its routing rules.

metricDesc.requests: All requests routed in the period, including failed and retried ones.

metricDesc.cache_hit_rate: Share of requests served from cache (exact or semantic match).
metricDesc.prompt_cache_ratio: Share of input tokens served from the cache rather than re-sent to the provider.
metricDesc.latency_p50: Median end-to-end request duration; half of the requests finished faster.
metricDesc.latency_p95: Duration within which 95% of requests finished; the slowest 5% took longer.
metricDesc.ttft_p50: Median time to the first streamed token.
metricDesc.ttft_p95: Time to the first streamed token that 95% of requests did not exceed.
